import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 12345678;
    static final int MAXN = 1000;

    static class Cell {
        int x, y, id;
        Cell(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
        Cell(int x, int y, int id) { this.x = x; this.y = y; this.id = id; }
    }

    static class Capacity {
        int[] ids = new int[10]; // enough for single digit (max 9)
        int count;
        int active;
    }

    static int n, limit;
    static int[] leftMatch = new int[MAXN + 1];
    static int[] rightMatch = new int[MAXN + 1];
    static int[] visited = new int[MAXN + 1];
    static char[][] gridA = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distA = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distB = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static Capacity[][] caps = new Capacity[MAXN][MAXN];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAXN + 1];
    static Queue<Cell> q = new LinkedList<>();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        limit = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize distA
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                distA[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        // Read gridA
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // Read gridB
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // BFS from 'Z' cells
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Cell start = new Cell(i, j);
                    bfsFrom(start);
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize caps and assign IDs to capacity cells (right side)
        int marker = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                caps[i][j] = new Capacity();
                if (Character.isDigit(gridB[i][j])) {
                    int k = gridB[i][j] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) caps[i][j].active = 1;
                    caps[i][j].count = k;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        caps[i][j].ids[l] = marker++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize adjacency list
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAXN; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        // Assign IDs to start cells (left side) and BFS
        marker = 1; // Note: This resets marker? Actually original continues from previous marker. But original code does not reset marker; it continues incrementing. So we need to keep the previous marker value. Let's correct: marker should not be reset. We'll use a separate variable for left IDs.
        // Actually the original code uses the same marker variable for both, so left IDs start after right IDs. So we should not reset marker. Let's fix: remove the reset.
        // We'll use a variable leftMarker that starts from the current marker value.
        int leftMarker = marker; // marker is now the next ID after right IDs
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j])) {
                    int k = gridA[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        Cell start = new Cell(i, j, leftMarker++);
                        bfsTo(start);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int totalLeft = leftMarker - 1; // number of left nodes
        System.out.println(maxMatching(totalLeft));
    }

    static void bfsFrom(Cell start) {
        int i = start.x, j = start.y;
        distA[i][j] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.add(start);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Cell temp = q.poll();
            i = temp.x; j = temp.y;
            if (gridA[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            // up
            if (i - 1 >= 0 && distA[i - 1][j] > distA[i][j] + 1) {
                distA[i - 1][j] = distA[i][j] + 1;
                q.add(new Cell(i - 1, j));
            }
            // down
            if (i + 1 < n && distA[i + 1][j] > distA[i][j] + 1) {
                distA[i + 1][j] = distA[i][j] + 1;
                q.add(new Cell(i + 1, j));
            }
            // left
            if (j - 1 >= 0 && distA[i][j - 1] > distA[i][j] + 1) {
                distA[i][j - 1] = distA[i][j] + 1;
                q.add(new Cell(i, j - 1));
            }
            // right
            if (j + 1 < n && distA[i][j + 1] > distA[i][j] + 1) {
                distA[i][j + 1] = distA[i][j] + 1;
                q.add(new Cell(i, j + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfsTo(Cell start) {
        // Reset distB
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                distB[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        int i = start.x, j = start.y;
        distB[i][j] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.add(start);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Cell temp = q.poll();
            i = temp.x; j = temp.y;
            if (distB[i][j] > limit) continue;
            if (gridA[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            if (caps[i][j].active == 1) {
                if (distB[i][j] <= limit && distB[i][j] <= distA[i][j]) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= caps[i][j].count; k++) {
                        adj[start.id].add(caps[i][j].ids[k]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (distB[i][j] >= distA[i][j]) continue;
            // up
            if (i - 1 >= 0 && distB[i - 1][j] > distB[i][j] + 1) {
                distB[i - 1][j] = distB[i][j] + 1;
                q.add(new Cell(i - 1, j));
            }
            // down
            if (i + 1 < n && distB[i + 1][j] > distB[i][j] + 1) {
                distB[i + 1][j] = distB[i][j] + 1;
                q.add(new Cell(i + 1, j));
            }
            // left
            if (j - 1 >= 0 && distB[i][j - 1] > distB[i][j] + 1) {
                distB[i][j - 1] = distB[i][j] + 1;
                q.add(new Cell(i, j - 1));
            }
            // right
            if (j + 1 < n && distB[i][j + 1] > distB[i][j] + 1) {
                distB[i][j + 1] = distB[i][j] + 1;
                q.add(new Cell(i, j + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean findPath(int u) {
        if (visited[u] == 1) return false;
        visited[u] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
            int v = adj[u].get(i);
            if (leftMatch[v] == -1) {
                leftMatch[v] = u;
                rightMatch[u] = i;
                return true;
            } else if (findPath(leftMatch[v])) {
                leftMatch[v] = u;
                rightMatch[u] = i;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int maxMatching(int nodes) {
        Arrays.fill(leftMatch, -1);
        Arrays.fill(rightMatch, -1);
        boolean done;
        do {
            done = true;
            Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; i++) {
                if (rightMatch[i] == -1 && findPath(i)) {
                    done = false;
                }
            }
        } while (!done);
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; i++) {
            if (rightMatch[i] != -1) cnt++;
        }
        return cnt;
    }
}
